import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(1000000)
memo = {}

def rec(n):
    if n <= 11:
        return min(n, 13 - n)
    if n in memo:
        return memo[n]
    x = 1
    c = 1
    while x < n:
        x = x * 10 + 1
        c += 1
    if x > 2 * n:
        # use repunit with one fewer digit
        prev_x = x // 10
        prev_c = c - 1
        ans = (n // prev_x) * prev_c + rec(n % prev_x)
    else:
        # both options
        prev_x = x // 10
        prev_c = c - 1
        opt1 = rec(x - n) + c
        opt2 = (n // prev_x) * prev_c + rec(n % prev_x)
        ans = min(opt1, opt2)
    memo[n] = ans
    return ans

s = int(input())
print(rec(s))
